title: Agent Plugins: OpenAI, Microsoft, Vercel Back One Standard
excerpt: On August 6, 2026, five companies backed Agent Plugins 1.0.0, an open, vendor-neutral packaging format that wraps MCP servers and Agent Skills into a portable directory. The steering committee spans AWS, Cursor maker Anysphere, Microsoft, OpenAI, and Vercel, with GitHub as an early collaborator. The article details the minimal plugin.json manifest structure, the skills/ and mcp.json layout, and explains how the standard collapses per-client packaging variants into one artifact that carries across supporting clients.
